title: A gate on the model
goal: Ask for a route and compare a model with the actual entrance.

memoryNodes.cue: What was here before the garden?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 花园规划之前，这里是什么？

memoryNodes.cue: Where is the gate in the model?
memoryNodes.cueZh: 模型中的大门在什么位置？

situation: An old map rested beside a small model of a downtown square. On the map, Lin followed a blue line to the bus stop. This site had once been part of a private estate, the note said. Now the plan showed a circular garden. Thin wooden posts stood around its edge, with a gate facing the road. On paper, arriving looked simple. At the real bus stop, Lin asked a worker, "Which way is the entrance?" He pointed across the square. A delivery van stood beside the gate, leaving a narrow gap. Lin waited while a parent tried to get through with a pram. The parent turned back. The model had shown an open path, but it had not shown the van. Lin wrote a question in her notebook: would this entrance work when people needed it? Before asking for a change, she wanted to check the other side.
zhSupport: 先看旧地图，再看模型木柱，最后看实际通道。estate 此处指土地；posts 此处是柱杆。路线询问与现场比较是原创学习任务，不是原教材例句。

glossary.note: downtown 在此修饰 square；原词项保留市中心的这一用法。

glossary.zh: 一处私有庄园的一部分
glossary.note: estate 在本课是土地；不是售房中介，也不是本文未谈及的遗产义。
本句指形状，不是循环过程。
向现场人员询问方向；也可问 Which way should I go?
get through 在此指穿过狭窄通道；不要套用完成工作这一义。

retrievalPrompts.cue: You have arrived at the bus stop. Ask a worker how to find the entrance.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Ask a short question that the worker can answer by pointing.

retrievalPrompts.cue: Your friend has only the model. Explain where its gate is.
acceptableAnswers: The gate faces the road, beside the wooden posts.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Use a position that your friend can find on the model.

retrievalPrompts.cue: Tell the planner what the model missed and why it matters to a parent.
acceptableAnswers: The model shows an open path, but a van leaves a narrow gap. A parent cannot get through with a pram.
retrievalPrompts.feedback: Link an observed obstacle to a person who needs access.

transferPrompt.cue: A new library has a wide entrance on its plan. Suggest one check before it opens.
acceptableAnswers: I would visit the site and check whether a parent can get through with a pram.
transferPrompt.feedback: Move the check to a new place; do not assume the library has the same van.
